'''Perlemia''' was an [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]]<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Perlemia system/Legends|Perlemia system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA Perlemia" /> It was the site of famous [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. Perlemia's [[starshipwright]]s constructed many of the [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ships]] used to [[Star map/Legends|chart]] the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] that would become,<ref name="EGTW" /> upon the signing of the [[Corellian Treaty (25,000 BBY)|Corellian Treaty]]<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> in [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' states that the [[Corellian Treaty (25,000 BBY)|Corellian Treaty]] "established [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] and its [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|trade routes]]," referring to the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the founding of these two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] to [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]].</ref> one of the two formal boundaries of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] region. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] would accordingly become known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].<ref name="CCW" />

Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the onset of the [[Tionese War]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion]]<ref name="EGTW" /> beginning in [[24,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> after the Republic belatedly realized the threat posed by [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] raiders, it began a crash program of producing [[Warship/Legends|warships]], including at Perlemia's shipyards. However, the effort came too late, with Tionese [[Starship/Legends|ships]] unleashing new [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] known as [[pressure bomb]]s that nearly completely destroyed the Perlemian facilities.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Perlemia was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Perlemia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Perlemia itself, in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA Perlemia" />
